verdict_text:
NO

The visible transform logic satisfies clauses 1 through 4 and all four required checks: the two regexes use `fullmatch` and name exactly the 64 projection matrices and 48 buffers, the cast is `float().to(bfloat16)` as specified, every other tensor is upcast to float32, names are unchanged, and the asserts run before writing. Clause 5 (the sharded layout) is not implemented in the artifact at all; it is delegated to `save_sharded_safetensors` from an unseen `_ckpt` module, so nothing in the script guarantees an index file named `model.safetensors.index.json` with a complete `weight_map`, a per-shard data total of at most 268,435,456 bytes, or that `embed_in.weight` and `embed_out.weight` each occupy their own shard. The same module supplies `load_checkpoint`, so even the safetensors read path is unverified. As presented, the artifact cannot be confirmed to meet clause 5 of "Required result".
note: experimenter: set `detected` (true if the stated problem matches expected_defect; for a correct artifact, true means a false alarm).
